rationale: At 4.50 ns both runs passed with +0.44/+0.46 ns slack (T_eff 4.06/4.04). Setup is still the only limiter (ss 100C 1.60V max-RC; port and reg-to-reg paths within 0.06 ns). Hold (+0.078 ns, no hold buffers), slew/cap (0 vs bar 89), DRC (0) and wirelength (~6% over estimate) leave ample room. Final slack tracks the larger repair margin plus ~0.05-0.1 ns, and the target is at its floor, so raise both margins to the 0.4 maximum (post-GRT from 0.39; placement, where 0.32 edged 0.23), which also pushes the re-runs harder. Keep the proven target/synthesis/placement/RC pins; drop the ABC-buffering pin (bm64 did well without it; history favours true) to stay within 8.
